question: What Are the Types of Pressure Transmitters?
body_html:
Types of pressure transmitters commonly used in process plants are fixed, smart and differential pressure transmitters, all usually giving a 4 to 20 mA output.

TypeKey featureTypical use
Fixed (FPT)Compact, fixed range, 24 V DC two wirePipeline pressure in water and process plants
Smart (SPT)Adjustable range, optional HARTProcess plants needing range changes
Differential (DP)Measures difference between two pointsFlow, level and filter monitoring
